 Magazine What RBI’s Rate Hike Means for India’s Renewable Energy Industry
 Developers expect higher borrowing costs to affect project returns, payback periods, and manufacturing expansion
 October 28, 2026
 / Melvin Mathew / Finance and M&A , Markets & Policy , Renewable Energy Follow Mercom India on WhatsApp for exclusive updates on clean energy news and insights 
 The Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) 25-basis-point increase in the repo rate to 5.5% could raise borrowing costs for renewable energy developers and manufacturers, potentially affecting project returns, financing decisions, and capacity expansion plans.
